species: rat (Sprague-Dawley); rat brain astrocyte cell line (RBAC, CTX TNA2)
readout_other: Western blot for BDNF, GDNF, VEGF, GLUT1; MTT cell growth/viability assay; RGD peptide integrin inhibition; 11C-PIB microPET imaging and regional biodistribution; TUNEL staining for apoptosis
direction_notes: LIPUS increased astrocyte and brain BDNF, GDNF, VEGF and GLUT1 expression (partly via integrin signalling), increased the AlCl3 LD50 in vitro, and reduced demyelination (11C-PIB uptake) and apoptosis (TUNEL) in AlCl3-treated rats; no direct neuronal excitation/inhibition was assessed.

exposures.label: LIPUS sonication of cultured rat brain astrocytes (RBAC)

target.label: rat brain astrocyte cells (RBAC, CTX TNA2)

timing.protocol_description: LIPUS was generated by a 1-MHz plane piezoelectric transducer with 50 ms burst lengths at a 50% duty cycle and a repetition frequency of 10 Hz, transmitted from the plane transducer to the bottom of the cell culture plate. Astrocyte cells were treated with multiple LIPUS stimulations by triple sonications; the duration of each sonication was 5 min with a 5 min interval between sonications, for a total sonication time of 15 min. A duty-cycle range from 0-100% was also tested for cell growth (Fig. 1A), but 50% duty cycle was used for the reported neurotrophic-factor and mechanistic experiments.

exposures.label: LIPUS sonication of rat brain (in vivo)

target.label: rat brain hemisphere (3.5 mm posterior, 2.5 mm lateral to bregma)

timing.protocol_description: LIPUS was generated by a 1-MHz focused piezoelectric transducer with 50 ms burst lengths at a 5% duty cycle and a repetition frequency of 1 Hz, directed at a region 3.5 mm posterior and 2.5 mm lateral to bregma. Each rat hemisphere was treated with multiple LIPUS stimulations by triple sonications; the duration of each sonication was 5 min with a 5 min interval between sonications, for a total sonication time of 15 min. LIPUS was applied daily for 49 days, starting 7 days before AlCl3 administration and continuing through the 42 days of AlCl3 administration.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twentyfour SD rats were randomized into four groups, each with 6 animals: a control group, a LIPUS group, an $\mathsf { A l C l } _ { 3 }$ group, and an LIPUS AlCl<sub>3</sub> group.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: LIPUS was applied daily for 49 days from 7 days before $\mathsf { A l C l } _ { 3 }$ administration began and lasted until the animals were sacrificed on day 42 of the $\mathsf { A l C l } _ { 3 }$ administration.

flags.reason: Total ultrasound-exposed animal count across sub-experiments is not stated; group sizes reported are the main AlCl3 study's two LIPUS-exposed arms (LIPUS n=6, LIPUS+AlCl3 n=6) plus a separate normal-rat western-blot pilot (Fig. 5, n=4); in vitro astrocyte culture replicate counts (typically n=4 per assay) are excluded from this animal-only count because model_system includes both rodent and in_vitro_cell.

The in vivo sonicated site is described only by stereotaxic coordinates (3.5 mm posterior, 2.5 mm lateral to bregma) and as 'rat hemisphere'; no specific named brain structure (e.g., hippocampus) is stated for the sonication target itself in this paper.

A duty-cycle dose-response from 0-100% was tested for cell growth optimisation (Fig. 1A) but only readable from the figure; the single value (50%) used for the reported neurotrophic-factor experiments is the one taken from the text.
This study reports biochemical/neuroprotective and imaging outcomes (neurotrophic factor expression, demyelination, apoptosis) rather than a direct measure of neuronal excitation or inhibition.

This exposure is an in vitro cell-culture (bath/dish) preparation with no skull or tissue path; in_situ is recorded as not_reported (rather than null) because the record also includes an in vivo exposure and model_system is not tissue/cell-only.
